long_biography.plain_text:
VIVA Group's operating method reflects Oliver Klima's focus on properties with unrealised potential. Its teams use due diligence to identify acquisitions, then combine renovation and direct management with eventual sales. Rather than specialise in one building type, the company has worked across apartments, mixed-use schemes, offices and industrial premises.

A 2016 acquisition in Wolfsburg shows the model in practice. VIVA bought two ageing high-rise properties containing 440 flats and assumed responsibility for management. Klima and fellow shareholder Willi Heise emphasised renovation and communication with tenants as ways to restore occupancy. Later investments included a terraced-house project in Worpswede and an industrial property in Frankfurt an der Oder.
